notes:
This is a blurry grayscale scan of a printout, 918x706 px. The axis runs from 10 to 0 with "ppm" printed at the right end. There is no title, compound number, frequency or solvent text. A structure is drawn at top centre: two indole-type units, an N-SO2Ph label, an NH, a prenyl group and CH2CHO arms. A long run of vertical peak ppm labels runs from 9.661 down to about 0.079. There are no annotations, no insets and no vertical intensity axis.

Integral layout: 22 values are printed sideways below the axis, reading bottom to top. Each value sits in a narrow frame between vertical rule lines. Slanted leader lines join the top of each frame to a tick that marks its region just under the axis. The frames are open at the bottom. No integral curves or brackets are drawn on the trace itself, so I chose "boxed values below axis".

Each glyph is only about 5x7 px. I settled the disputed values by comparing pixels against glyphs both transcribers agreed on in the same image:
- Box 5 (about 7.9 ppm) reads 0.79, not 0.98. The third character is a thin stem with a top bar and no foot, which is a 7. The 9s elsewhere have a dense top loop.
- Box 8 reads 5.47, not 3.47. The first character has an upper-left stroke, as in the agreed 5 of 5.88. The agreed 3s have no upper-left stroke.
- Box 9 reads 5.88, not 5.08. The third character is the same solid dark blob as the agreed 8 in 0.87, and the fourth shows two loops with a middle bar.
- Box 10 reads 4.44. The last character has an open top, a crossbar and a right stem, like the agreed 4.
- The about-3.65 ppm value reads 3.77, but with low confidence: 2.77 is possible. The lower-right bowl is more like a 3.
- The about-1.75 ppm middle value reads 3.72, not 3.12. The third character has a faint top bar and no foot. Every agreed 1 in this font has a heavy foot.
- The values at about 3.05, 2.8 and 2.4 ppm read 0.90, 0.96 and 0.85, not 3.30, 3.36 and 3.85. The first characters have a faint but continuous left stroke, about 36-45 darkness units. The agreed 0s measure about 55-83 and the agreed 3s about 13-14. The third characters at 3.05 and 2.8 ppm end in a left-heavy lower tail like the agreed 9s; the bottoms of the 3s here are centre or right heavy.

The leading 3s of 3.19 and 3.47 (agreed) have no left stroke, unlike these three.
